description.html: HabiStat Crested Gecko Diet Banana is made by the British brand HabiStat for crested geckos and other reptiles that eat both fruit and insects. Banana powder makes up 52% of the recipe, and protein comes from 9 different sources. Ingredients include pea protein isolate, brown rice protein, spirulina, brewer's yeast, bee pollen, honey, seaweed, spinach, chamomile and marigold, with added vitamins A, D3 and E. The manufacturer states the food has no artificial colors, preservatives or fillers.

Mix about 5g of powder with water to a soft, ketchup-like consistency and serve it in a shallow dish, ideally in the evening. The manufacturer recommends 5g once or twice a week as part of a varied diet based mainly on insects. Remove uneaten food after 24 hours and store the powder in a cool, dry place.
Besides crested geckos, other gecko species, anoles, lacertid lizards, skinks and iguanas can eat it too. Tips on combining it with live food are on our lizard food page.
